surface: REST v3 GET /orgs/{org}/audit-log (GitHub Enterprise Cloud; membership-removal events org.remove_member, org.remove_outside_collaborator)
auth_scope: read:audit_log scope on an organization-owner principal (the audit log is owner-visible only)

pagination.exhaustion_method: follow the after cursor from the Link rel="next" header until absent; per_page=100

rate_limits: REST core limit (5000 requests/hour) plus a dedicated audit-log endpoint throttle; honor Retry-After on 403/429
history_caveats: Audit log query window is 180 days for organization events on this plan (Git events only 7 days) - TIMING assertions beyond the window need audit log streaming or an exported archive
Membership-removal events exist only on GitHub Enterprise Cloud plans; plain org plans keep a shorter, UI-only audit trail
